name: North Cascades
about: The North Cascades Highway through the park closes completely each winter (roughly Dec–Mar); summer (Jul–Aug) is the only real window for the high alpine trails, though Mount Baker's ski area stays open, reached by a different road.
overview: Nicknamed the 'American Alps' — more glaciers than any US park outside Alaska, the turquoise waters of Diablo Lake, and genuinely serious alpine hiking, all remarkably uncrowded even in peak season.
costOverview: One of the least commercialized national parks in the system — basic supplies and permits are the main costs, aside from a day at Mount Baker's ski area nearby.

specialSeasons.text: The North Cascades Highway (Route 20) through the park closes completely for winter — Mount Baker's ski area, reached from a different road, stays open.
